purpose: natural-green-v3 isolated browser visual material after; not gameplay or TapTap device evidence

artLimits: Architecture retains compatible shared natural-v3 cutout families; it is not a unique illustration for every named building.
Nine v2 painted ground textures are RGB 512 square with repeat/linear mip sampling; local preparation adjusts broad illumination, palette and narrow opposing edge pixels.
Twelve new rock/grass/fern/reed sprites preserve their full-resolution transparent atlas and separately inspected crop bounds.
Tree foliage reuses the original natural-v3 atlas with selective brightness/saturation in oak/birch/pine green pixels; alpha and all non-tree sprites remain exact.
Pixel edge continuity does not itself establish visually seamless patterns; 3x3 tiling and normal camera review remain separate.
Original 32 terrain values, geography, entrances and saved coordinates remain authoritative; new campaign landforms use the same tested terrain/navigation path.
Processed source coverage does not establish playthrough completion, occlusion correctness or physical-phone performance.
